{{Quote|A bunch of sand pirates are interfering with my business partners.|[[Coris Mao]], to a commando|<ref name="SWG:FD" />}}
The '''Sand Pirates''' were a group of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] who operated on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]

==History==
{{Quote|Any transport that gets within a thousand meters of their base tends to have some unfortunate accidents&hellip;at the end of blaster bolts.|Coris Mao, to a commando|<ref name="SWG:FD" />}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Sand Pirates were based in a [[Sand Pirate Base|bunker]] located near the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Entha/Legends|Mos Entha]]. They used to attack any [[Transport/Legends|transport]] which found itself close to their base.<ref name="SWG:FD" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the pirates caused many troubles to local [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] and interfered with the activities of [[Coris Mao]]'s business partners. Mao finally contacted [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Snopel]],<ref name="SWG:FD" /> a retired [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]],<ref name="SWG:C">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Commando|Commando|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref> in order to got rid of the pirates. Snopel therefore dispatched a group of commandos under training to deal with the pirates. The commandos attacked the Sand Pirate Base and killed a large number of pirates. They also eliminated the pirate boss and eventually blew up the base, thus disrupting the pirate activities for a long time.<ref name="SWG:FD" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sand Pirates appeared in [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:FD" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Sand Pirates were added to the game upon the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
